_comment: Aurora Mail desktop configuration. Copy or rename this file to config.json under your platform's AppDataLocation (macOS: ~/Library/Application Support/Aurora; Linux: ~/.local/share/Aurora; Windows: %LOCALAPPDATA%/Aurora). See desktop/src/Core/Config/AppConfig.hpp for the schema.
_locale_help: BCP-47-ish locale tag for the UI. Supported out of the box: 'uk' (Ukrainian) and '' (system default, falls back to English source strings). Add more by writing a desktop/translations/aurora-mail_<tag>.ts file and rebuilding.
